title: HexIDE theme pack
description: A HexIDE theme pack: a name, a light/dark hint, and a set of colour overrides applied to the IDE chrome. Every key is optional except 'name' — a pack overrides only the colours it lists, and inherits the rest from the built-in Classic palette.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editor completion and validation.

name.description: Display name, shown in Options → Environment. Must match the pack's file name, since HexIDE loads packs by file name.

description.description: One line explaining the pack, shown alongside the name.

themeVariant.description: Which base theme the pack sits on. 'Dark' selects Avalonia's dark variant; anything else selects light. Set this to match your palette — a dark palette on the light variant leaves built-in controls light.

colors.description: Colour overrides, keyed by role. Unknown keys are ignored with a warning in the log.

AppWorkspace.description: The MDI workspace behind all child windows — the largest single area of the IDE.

Window.description: Background of editable surfaces: the code editor, list boxes, text fields.

WindowText.description: Text on 'Window' surfaces. Needs at least 4.5:1 against it.

ActiveCaptionText.description: Text in the active title bar. Needs contrast against 'ActiveTitleBar', not against 'Window'.

Control.description: Face of dialogs, toolbars, panels and buttons — the IDE's dominant chrome colour.

ControlDark.description: Outer bevel shadow. In a flat palette, set the four bevel colours close together.

ControlLightLight.description: Brightest bevel edge — the top-left of a raised control.

ControlDarkDark.description: Darkest bevel edge — the bottom-right of a raised control.

Highlight.description: Selection fill — selected text, list rows, menu items under the cursor.

HighlightText.description: Text drawn on 'Highlight'. Check this pair carefully; it is the one most often left unreadable.

Desktop.description: The desktop colour role. Rarely visible in HexIDE; kept for completeness.

GrayText.description: Disabled text, and the indeterminate check mark.

InactiveCaption.description: Title bar of an unfocused MDI child.

InactiveCaptionText.description: Text in an unfocused title bar.

ActiveTitleBar.description: Title bar of the focused MDI child. Classic VB6 uses #000080.

InactiveTitleBar.description: Title bar fill for unfocused child windows.

DockTitleBar.description: Header of docked tool windows — Project Explorer, Properties, Toolbox.

SelectionAdorner.description: Fill of the eight sizing handles around a selected control in the form designer.

SelectionAdornerBorder.description: Outline of those handles. Contrast against 'SelectionAdorner' keeps them visible over any control.

FormGridPattern.description: The form designer's alignment dots. Keep this subtle — it tiles across the whole form.

ControlSpawnerPhantom.description: The outline preview drawn while dragging a new control onto a form.

RubberBandFill.description: Fill of the marquee selection rectangle. Use an 8-digit #AARRGGBB value — this one is meant to be translucent.

ColorPaletteBorder.description: Grid lines in the colour picker.

ColorPaletteHighlight.description: Selected swatch indicator in the colour picker.

WarningBannerBackground.description: Fill of the in-IDE warning banner, such as the read-only file notice. The built-in value is a light amber; a dark pack should override it.

ValidationError.description: Validation error text in dialogs. The built-in red is tuned for light chrome; darker packs usually need a lighter red.

SystemAccentColor.description: Base accent, used by controls that draw their own emphasis. Stored as a colour rather than a brush, so translucent values are not meaningful here.

SystemAccentColorLight1.description: One step lighter than the base accent.

SystemAccentColorLight2.description: Two steps lighter than the base accent.

SystemAccentColorDark1.description: One step darker than the base accent.

SystemAccentColorDark2.description: Two steps darker than the base accent.

color.description: A colour as #RGB, #ARGB, #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB, or a named colour. Alpha comes first in the 4- and 8-digit forms.
